versions.changelog: Security scan coherence: document Node.js + npm install requirements; package.json already included.
Security scan improvements: add package.json dependency declaration; make offline_access optional (reduce long-lived token risk); docs + process cleanups.

Quickstart now asks business vs consumer first; add trigger keywords (MS365/Microsoft365, hotmail/outlook/live, OneDrive/SharePoint/Exchange Online); clarify business note for users without IT admin rights.
Make setup deppensicher: require clientId; add enterprise locked-down tenant guidance; add raw-token fallback importer and token-cache autodetect.
Fix consumer device-code UX: require --clientId, stable message output; setup script passes clientId.
Improve device-code sign-in instructions; document consumer-account requirement (app must allow personal Microsoft accounts).
Add one-command setup helper; anonymize docs/examples (no personal emails).
Initial release: device-code auth, list/search/get/move events; supports business (organizations) + consumer (consumers).
